content.tex: INVESTIGATION SQUARES ON GRIDS
This investigation looks at the number of squares drawn on square grids.
All squares are drawn using gridlines.
Here is a 2 by 2 grid.
Explain why there are 5 squares on a 2 by 2 grid.
